name: Naive Voxel Mesh Generation
definition: A mesh generation algorithm that iterates over every block in a chunk and generates a full 8-vertex cube for every non-air block, regardless of whether the faces are visible or occluded.
summary: Naive Voxel Mesh Generation is a block-based algorithm that creates a full 8-vertex cube for every solid block, resulting in a dense, redundant mesh regardless of occlusion.
